title: Thickness reverse (-9 pattern)
trigger: Part has distinct rib thickness and eye-end thickness, or user reports features extruded in reverse.
checks: Confirm rib thickness and end thickness separately against the drawing labels.
If reversed: rebuild as blank at rib thickness and pocket ends to end thickness.

title: Bevel W × A° math (C32057-51 pattern)
trigger: Compound bevel callout of the form W × A° on a plate of thickness T.
checks: Measured bevel width must match W, not T/tan(A).
Verify both mirrored bevels from the built model.
Confirm sketch origins so left and right sides match.

title: Verify mirrored features both sides
trigger: Any symmetric or mirrored geometry (bevels, hole columns, flanges).
checks: Measure both sides from the built model.
Do not trust a single-side sketch origin.

title: Units mm after new_design
checks: Call document.units with units=mm immediately after new_design.
